diagnosis: ECR Public rejected the immutable manifest request with a data-limit response before Docker build instructions ran. Quota consumption and its owner remain unknown. A later successful attempt does not establish a permanent provider fix.
fix: Select the official Docker Hub repository directly; change only the registry prefix in both Telegram Node bases. No retries, mirrors, credentials, version changes or CI changes.

metadataVerification.method: Anonymous crane manifest requests with empty DOCKER_CONFIG, no layer pulls; hash raw index bytes and compare ECR and Hub bytes.
metadataVerification.tagNote: The current Hub tag resolves to a different digest. The existing pinned digest remains readable; Dockerfile tag is descriptive and its digest selects the immutable content.
metadataVerification.limitation: Metadata access from the owner Mac is not hosted build evidence. Docker Hub quotas remain a provider dependency; this scoped fix removes the confirmed ECR failure path.
